description: Checks a JSON value against a JSON Schema (drafts 4, 7, 2019-09 and 2020-12) and lists every violation with its location. Use it to confirm structured output or an API payload is correct before sending it. `data` and `schema` may be JSON values or JSON strings.

data.description: The JSON value to check (any type), or a JSON string of it

schema.description: The JSON Schema (object), or a JSON string of it

name: json_schema_validate
title: Validate JSON against a schema
